addons.name: Ghostery – Privacy Ad Blocker
addons.description: The best privacy tool and ad blocker extension for Firefox. Stop trackers, speed up websites and block ads everywhere including YouTube and Facebook.
addons.fullDescription:
Ads slowing down your browsing?

Ghostery blocks ads instantly on YouTube, Facebook, and across the web while protecting your privacy automatically.

Install once and Ghostery quietly removes ads, stops trackers, and handles cookie popups so you can enjoy a cleaner, faster web.

More than an ad blocker. Ghostery shows what others hide.
Trusted by millions of users for 15+ years, counting more than 100+ million downloads worldwide.

Ghostery for Firefox provides safe, fast, and clutter-free browsing for free. The browser extension upgrades your Firefox browser and supplies full adblock functionality, stops trackers from accessing your personal data, and annoying cookie consent pop-ups.

Ghostery has three main components:

    Ad-Blocking - blocks all ads on websites you visit with your Firefox browser, including Youtube and Facebook, helping you to focus only on the information important to you.
    Anti-Tracking - stops trackers’ ability to collect your personal data, replacing it with random values and anonymizing your identity for data brokers. If you see a need to unblock individual trackers, we developed this option. The reasons are up to you!
    Never-Consent - automatically removes intrusive cookie popups and expresses dissent to online tracking. This unequaled feature adds convenience to each website visit and acts like your privacy advocate towards content providers while using Firefox.


Ghostery delivers the online privacy protection our users have come to know and love while minimising the need for customisation and maintenance.

As Ghostery is more than an ad-blocker, it comes with exceptional additional features, not found in any other ad-blocking extension:

    Trackers information on any website your visit, informing you about the number of trackers, their type, and the company operating them.
    Trackers Preview on search engine result pages - displaying tracker information even before you visit a page. You can safely make the choice to visit it, as Ghostery will stop trackers expecting you on the landing page.
    WhoTracks.Me - Owning and operating the largest database of trackers allows Ghostery to update tracker information fast and reliably for all users.


Moreover, Ghostery is:

    Open source
    Supported by thousands of contributors worldwide
    Free to use forever


Ghostery is free for everyone. Take back control over your digital privacy and become a Contributor to Ghostery. Contributors help Ghostery fund the development of the Privacy Suite and WhoTracks.Me, the largest database of trackers in the world.

Become a Contributor and help Ghostery fight for privacy as a human right!

addons.name: Time Tracker - Web Habit Builder
addons.description: Track time, analyze your habits and block addictive sites
addons.fullDescription:
Time Tracker - Web Habit Builder is a free, privacy-first web habit builder that automatically logs screen time, provides accurate analytics, and blocks distracting sites — keeping all data strictly local and under your control. 🚀

🌟 CORE CAPABILITIES

⏱ Track and Audit Time: Automatically monitor active web usage with a high-accuracy engine. No account required. It ensures every second is correctly recorded for a truthful view of your screen time.

📊 Analyze Digital Habits: Gain deep insights through multidimensional reports. Visualize productivity by Site, Category, or Tab Group. Works fully offline with zero data leakage.

🛡 Block Addictive Sites: Reclaim your focus with an integrated website blocker. Set flexible time limits and rules to break addictive browsing cycles and maximize deep work.

🔍 Precision "Virtual Sites": Beyond domain tracking, define specific sub-page URLs (like a YouTube video or Notion doc) for granular monitoring once configured.

🔒 DATA OWNERSHIP AND TRANSPARENCY

🏠 Local-Only Storage: 100% of your history stays on your machine. The extension does not collect, store, or transmit your data to any remote servers.

☁ User-Controlled Sync: You have the option to sync across devices using your own WebDAV, GitHub Gist, or Obsidian accounts. These connections are entirely managed and authorized by you.

⚖ MIT Licensed: Transparent and audit-ready code under the MIT License. No hidden tracking, no subscriptions.

🔄 SEAMLESS TRANSITION

📥 One-Click Import: Easily migrate from Webtime Tracker or Web Activity Time Tracker without losing your history.
💻 Cross-Browser: Native support for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge with automatic Dark Mode.

→ View Source Code: https://github.com/sheepzh/time-tracker-4-browser
→ Submit Issues: https://github.com/sheepzh/time-tracker-4-browser/issues
